SPECIFICATIONS

The front seats have been designed for optimum driving comfort and maximum safety, guaranteeing the ideal specifications for lateral containment and lumbar support.

In the front part of the seating area there is an excellent structure for anti-submarining, to prevent the body sliding forward under the seat belt in the case of strong deceleration (frontal impacts).

The backrest frame is mae from a pressed steel structure which improves the capacity for energy absorption in the case of strong acceleration (rear impact).

The seats are available in two versions:

  • semi-manual.
  • electric.

Semi-manual seats

The lengthwise adjustment and the adjustment of the head restraint take place through mechanical movement. The adjustment of the backrest (lumbar and height) is through electrical movement.

Electric seats

On both versions of the seat the heater function is available with three temperature settings:

  • temperature 1 - 36°C;
  • temperature 2 - 39°C;
  • temperature 3 - 44°C.

COMPOSITION

Head restraints

They are equipped with a height/angle adjustment device that allows them positioned stably in various intermediate positions with a travel of around 60 mm.

Seat belts

The front seat belts, with pretensioners, have a dual mounting on the seat.

The belt therefore follows the seat in the various positions that it can assume, adjusting to guarantee maximum safety conditions in all situations. There is a sensor on the seat belt stalk that signals the fastening status of the belt (control unit).

Side Air Bags

The Side Bag module is fitted on the outside of the seat backrest frame. This solution, as opposed to installation on the pillar or the door, means that the Bag is always in the optimum position in relation to the occupant, irrespective of the adjustment of the seat or the size of the occupant.

Passenger presence sensor

The passenger presence sensor is a device capable of identifying the presence of a weight on the passenger front seat cushion (up to about 12 kg).

The sensor is fitted in the seat between the upholstery and the cover and covers the entire seating area with the exception of the side panels.

Armrest

There is an arm rest between the front seats which can be opened and is height adjustable (4 positions) whch is secured to the lower centre trim.

There is a lever in the arm rest housing which allows the air conditioning vents to be opened and closed.

OPERATION

Adjustment

The shape of the seat and the extensive adjustment possibilities, together with the possibilities of adjusting the steering wheel and the exterior mirrors, means that the optimum driving position can be achieved for drivers of different sizes with different driving styles.

In addition to the adjustments (lengthwise, height, tilt, head restraint, lumbar) there is also a three position memory function (where fitted) for the driver's seat which, when the vehicle has been switched off and then started up again places the seat in the position memorized previously.

Control panel

Memorizing

The memorizing of the position of the driver's seat is carried out using one of three buttons (known as 1, 2 and 3) after having personalized the position of the seat, the steering column and the exterior rear view mirrors. The memorizing is carried out by pressing one of the three buttons for more than 3 seconds. To confirm that the memorizing has taken place the control unit (NAG) sends a message, via the CAN, to sound the confirmation buzzer.

COMFORT SEATS

Adaptation and massage function

The adaptation and massage functions are achieved by using a system that comprises of air bags, located between the cover and the upholstery. The quantity of air contained inside the bags is managed by an electronic control unit in order to produce the optimum pressure distribution depending on the dimensions, weight and position of the occupant of the seat. The massage function is produced by partly inflating and deflating the bags according to a predefined cycle.

The system usually works at between –20°C and + 65°C.

System features

The system components are illustrated in the figure below.

The "Adaptation" and "Massage" function management system components are:

  • an electronic control unit comprising an electronic card and pneumatic vales which have the function of regulating the amount of air in the individual bags;
  • an air pump;
  • air bags located in the cushion in the front and side areas and in the backrest in the lumbar region;
  • the wiring, connecting the electronic control unit and the air pump, the supply leads and the control signal transmission cables;
  • the pneumatic connecting pipes between the electronic control unit valves and the air bags and between the electronic control unit and the air pump.

The adaptation function is activated by the occupant; this activation features:

  • an initial stage for completely inflating the bags;
  • a second deflation stage controlled according to the pressure exerted by the occupant until an optimum distribution situation is reached.

Once the optimum configuration is reached, a check on the pressure distribution is carried out every four minutes giving rise to a new adjustment of the quantities of air in the bags. All the bags are involved in the adaptation function.

The massage function involves all the bags except for the ones located in the sides of the cushion. The occupant requests a massage with the cycle lasting four minutes, afterwards the system automatically returns to the adaptation cycle (for about 60 secs.) and then a new four minute cycle starts again.

The intensity of the lumbar support can be regulated during the massage stage. The massage and adaptation functions cannot be activated simultaneously since they are produced by the same system: as a result, if a massage cycle is activated, the seat adaptation function cannot be activated at the same time.

The intensity of the massage cycle is different for the driver and passenger seats.

The massage cycle sequence is as follows:

  • 1 left and right rear areas simultaneously
  • 2 lower lumbar support
  • 3 upper lumbar support
  • 4 lower lumbar support
  • 5 left and right rear areas simultaneously

Ventilation function

The ventilation function is produced by means of three fans (two in the cushion and one in the backrest) that produce a flow of air towards the occupant directed through the use of ducts in the foam and distributed evenly by means of special layers of breathable material. The heating is produced by means of a special highly permeable heater layer between the cushion and the backrest (with a temperature sensor in the cushion).

The ventilation is concentrated in the rear and side areas of the cushion and in the backrest. The cover is made from perforated leather.

The rear panel is perforated in the centre to allow air to circulate inside the backrest

The fans are controlled simultaneously by the NAG/NAP control unit at pre-defined constant speeds. The occupant can select three temperature settings for the heating.

Function management

The comfort functions for the front seat are managed using the controls on the seat trim and through the NIT user interface (screen with buttons in the dashboard).

The "NIT comfort menu activation" control is located on the trim.

The following controls are managed through the NIT panel user interface:

  • Adaptation activation / deactivation
  • Massage activation / deactivation
  • Ventilation activation / deactivation
  • Seat heating levels adjustment
